visualDescription.sceneDescriptionEn: A black and white engraving depicting a steam locomotive pulling a train across a high trestle bridge spanning a deep, mountainous valley. The landscape features steep, forested hillsides and a river visible in the distance at the bottom of the gorge. The sky is filled with textured clouds, and the train emits a plume of smoke.
